messages:
Zoe Kim: Heads-up - BlueHorizon wants an EU-only presales POC. Requirements: tenant pinned to eu-west-1, BYO KMS, VPC peering, signed subproc list. Can we triage owners?
Daniel Ho: I can take runbook & peering. Need CIDR, cert exchange checklist, and sample curl tests.
Priya Nair: Legal asks for signed subproc PDF + confirmation that no plaintext keys are stored. Also retention window and audit log access.
Miguel Torres: Infra: we support envelope encryption; only encrypted DEKs stored. For locality: Dedicated in eu-west-1 or hosted with routing_policy lock. Will export subproc list and mark EU-only vendors.
Lina Chen: I'll draft a short POC addendum: block cross-border routing for the window and require notification + pause right if failover proposed.
Daniel Ho: Runbook quick steps: 1) CIDR handshake; 2) PEM cert exchange; 3) KMS ARN + policy verify; 4) deploy demo slab; 5) smoke tests (traceroute, request ID).
Zoe Kim: Pricing ask: 1-week POC. Need hosted vs dedicated delta and any setup fees.
Miguel Torres: Ballpark: Dedicated demo slab ~€4.8k/wk; hosted hard-pin trial ~€1.0k/wk + KMS ops ~€350; peering/setup ~€200.
Priya Nair: Test matrix minimum: (1) all traffic originates/terminates in EU, (2) keys never leave customer KMS, (3) audit logs exported, (4) p95 latency <250ms for 256 tokens.
ops-bot: Ticket created RDW-1407 - "BlueHorizon EU POC: peering + BYO KMS + subproc attestation" assigned to @daniel.h
Zoe Kim: Action owners: Daniel runbook & ops ticket; Miguel subproc export + infra attestation; Priya addendum; pricing TBD by Alex/Finance. First draft by EOD tomorrow?
Everyone: +1
